theorem prop_9_3_2 {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (δ : ℝ) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0) (hG : GRHUpTo χ T0) :
    ‖Schar χ (fun n => ((Λ n * phi (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (δ / x) -
        (if q = 1 then 𝓕 (fun u => (phiPos u : ℂ)) (-δ) * x else 0)‖ ≤ err932N q T0 δ x * x :=

note: Side result: §9.6 uses it only to prove Thm 7.1.1, which no later chapter cites; Prop 9.3.2's proof proceeds 'as in' this one. Erratum: The proof prints |eta'|_2 + 2pi|delta||eta|_2 ≤ 0.942 + 4.183|delta| ≤ 1 + 5|delta|, which is |eta|_2 + 2pi|eta'|_2|delta| with the norms swapped; the correct value 0.665668 + 5.914967|delta| exceeds 1 + 5|delta| for |delta| > 0.3654, so the x^{-3/2} term should be (log q + 6)(1 + 6|delta|), with which the proof's closing inequality still holds. (checked by `scripts/checks/proposition_9_2_2.py`).
